extended:
**Arithmetic of Hyperbolic Manifolds** — Walter D. Neumann and Alan W. Reid. Survey.

Hyperbolic 3-manifolds here are complete orientable finite-volume quotients H³/Γ with Γ ⊂ PSL₂ℂ a Kleinian group. The arithmetic ones form a more tractable subclass because arithmetic invariants are available: an arithmetic M is determined up to commensurability by its defining field k (a number field with exactly one complex place) together with a quaternion algebra over k.

Covers the invariant trace field, the invariant quaternion algebra, commensurability classes, and the identification of arithmetic manifolds among all hyperbolic ones.

**Why it may bear here.** The invariant trace field and quaternion algebra are the arithmetic side of the same hyperbolic-volume objects this corpus uses geometrically (Vol(4₁), cusp shapes, the Bloch-group material). Relevance is a prior, not a verdict — no claim is made that a specific result is needed.
